title: Exploration of treatment strategies and susceptibility gene of postoperative nausea and vomiting in breast cancer patients: a randomised controlled trial
source_read: Complete9-page publication; visually checked flow and Tables1,3 pp4,6.
denominator_source: p929 Fig1;35 per treatment subgroup p928;2 postoperative-fever exclusions SNVP-ODT
population: 18–60 women breast cancer GA; Beijing Feb–Aug2022; history strata not randomized.
pain: Measured2,6,12,24,36h but no numerical pain result published.
rescue_regimen: Flurbiprofen axetil100mg if painVAS≥3; IV ondansetron4mg for severe PONV. All receive5mg dexamethasone induction and4mg ondansetron +100mg flurbiprofen at surgery end.
source_conflicts: Table3 MNVP-ODT12–24h asymptomatic33(5.7%) is percentage typo;33/35=94.3%; PONV2/35 unaffected.
SNVP vs MNVP is observational; only ODT vs OD within stratum randomized.
independence: One study with two disjoint randomized strata; no shared controls across strata; do not count as two independent studies.

rob2.comparison: ODT vs OD within SNVP and MNVP strata
